PLUGIN-10.name: NOTHING_TO_REMOVE
PLUGIN-10.description: Nothing by that name is installed on this machine.

PLUGIN-11.name: NOTHING_TO_UPDATE
PLUGIN-11.description: Nothing by that id is installed, so there is no version to replace.

PLUGIN-12.name: STUCK
PLUGIN-12.description: The version installed would not come off, so nothing else was touched.

PLUGIN-13.name: ANSWERED
PLUGIN-13.description: Raised when a plugin's service would answer on a label another plugin's already does.

PLUGIN-14.name: TWO_SOURCES
PLUGIN-14.description: Raised when a plugin is installed from a source other than the one its name is already installed from.

PLUGIN-15.name: SOURCE_OFF
PLUGIN-15.description: Raised when a plugin is named from a git source and fetching from one is switched off.

PLUGIN-16.name: UNFETCHED
PLUGIN-16.description: Raised when a git source could not be reached or would not hand over a revision.

PLUGIN-17.name: NO_REVISION
PLUGIN-17.description: Raised when a git source holds no branch, tag or commit by the name given.

PLUGIN-18.name: CATALOGUE_OFF
PLUGIN-18.description: Raised when a plugin is installed by name and asking the catalogue is switched off.

PLUGIN-19.name: CATALOGUE_UNREACHABLE
PLUGIN-19.description: Raised when the catalogue's index or its signature could not be fetched.

PLUGIN-2.name: UNREADABLE
PLUGIN-2.description: The source names no plugin this build can read.

PLUGIN-20.name: SIGNATURE_UNVERIFIED
PLUGIN-20.description: Raised when the catalogue's index has no signature, one that does not verify, or none this build carries a key to check.

PLUGIN-21.name: CATALOGUE_UNREADABLE
PLUGIN-21.description: Raised when the catalogue's index verified and is not one this build reads.

PLUGIN-22.name: NOT_CATALOGUED
PLUGIN-22.description: Raised when the catalogue holds no plugin by the name given.

PLUGIN-23.name: NOT_AS_REVIEWED
PLUGIN-23.description: Raised when what the catalogue's origin served is not what the catalogue reviewed.

PLUGIN-24.name: SPELLED_ALIKE
PLUGIN-24.description: Raised when a plugin's service would be named, where lemonfiber keeps what a service holds, as another installed plugin's service already is.

PLUGIN-25.name: PLUGIN_OFFER_MOVED
PLUGIN-25.description: Raised when an install, an update or a removal answers an offer that was read against a plugin, a stack or a record that has since moved.

PLUGIN-26.name: UNAPPROVED
PLUGIN-26.description: Raised when a value a recipe would carry to a destination, or the egress guard's shape a service would take, was not approved as itself, or an approval names something the reading does not list.

PLUGIN-27.name: ANOTHER_PLUGIN
PLUGIN-27.description: Raised when the source an update names holds a different plugin from the one it was asked to update.

PLUGIN-28.name: OCCUPIED
PLUGIN-28.description: Raised when a plugin's service would take a name, a port or a label something already on this machine holds: a service of the stack or of the operator's overlay, another plugin's port, or a site in the proxy's live configuration.

PLUGIN-29.name: CATALOGUE_REPLACED
PLUGIN-29.description: Raised when the catalogue's index verifies and is older than the newest one this machine has verified.

PLUGIN-3.name: REFUSED
PLUGIN-3.description: The manifest is read and this build refuses what it declares.

PLUGIN-30.name: NEWEST_UNKEPT
PLUGIN-30.description: Raised when the record of the newest catalogue index this machine verified cannot be read or written.

PLUGIN-31.name: SCHEME_REFUSED
PLUGIN-31.description: Raised when a git source is named over a transport other than https, before anything is asked of it.

PLUGIN-32.name: ADDRESS_REFUSED
PLUGIN-32.description: Raised when a git source's host is, or stands for, an address on this machine or on a network of its own: loopback, private, link-local or unspecified.

PLUGIN-33.name: HEADER_NAMED
PLUGIN-33.description: Raised when a recipe substitutes a value into a header's name, which is a fixed identifier of the protocol and written out; the manifest's every other fault is listed beside it.

PLUGIN-34.name: INPUT_UNMATCHED
PLUGIN-34.description: Raised when a recipe of the act asks the operator for a value that was not given, or a value was given that no recipe of the act asks for.

PLUGIN-35.name: CALL_REFUSED
PLUGIN-35.description: Raised when a recipe's call was not sent because its host stands for an address not out on the internet; the install or update was put back.

PLUGIN-36.name: STEP_FAILED
PLUGIN-36.description: Raised when a recipe's step failed any other way — nothing answered, the answer was not the one it expects, a capture found nothing, or the answer was larger than a recipe reads; the install or update was put back.

PLUGIN-37.name: PATH_NOT_PLAIN
PLUGIN-37.description: Raised when a recipe's call path is not a plain absolute path; the manifest's every other fault is listed beside it.

PLUGIN-38.name: VALUE_WITHHELD
PLUGIN-38.description: Raised when a recipe's call was not sent because a value it carries may not go where it was going: not where its pairs say, not back to the service a credential belongs to, or outside without its approval; the install or update was put back.

PLUGIN-39.name: NOTHING_TO_PROVE
PLUGIN-39.description: Nothing by that id is installed, so there is nothing to prove again.

PLUGIN-4.name: UNRECORDED
PLUGIN-4.description: The record of what is installed cannot be read.

PLUGIN-40.name: STRANGER_REPLACING
PLUGIN-40.description: Raised when a plugin that is not first-party declares a service replacing one the stack ships.

PLUGIN-44.name: NOTHING_TO_RUN
PLUGIN-44.description: Raised when a run names a plugin that is not installed, or a demand recipe the plugin does not declare.

PLUGIN-45.name: MANIFEST_UNKEPT
PLUGIN-45.description: Raised when the manifest kept for an installed plugin is missing or is not the one that was installed, so its demand recipes cannot be read.

PLUGIN-46.name: UNAIMED_CROSSING
PLUGIN-46.description: Raised when a third-party plugin declares a secret of another service that names no capability of its own it is for.

PLUGIN-47.name: NO_GRANT
PLUGIN-47.description: Raised when a grant asked to be revoked is not one the plugin holds.

PLUGIN-48.name: EARLIER_TAKEN
PLUGIN-48.description: Raised when a plugin's setting or secret names, as the variable an earlier release kept its value under, one another installed plugin's setting or secret names.

PLUGIN-49.name: ANOTHER_SOURCE
PLUGIN-49.description: Raised when a plugin carrying the id of a part this build pins comes from anywhere but that pin.

PLUGIN-50.name: UNCONFORMING
PLUGIN-50.description: Raised when a case of a contract a plugin's adapter speaks fails, or no recording the plugin ships answers it.

PLUGIN-51.name: KEY_UNREADABLE
PLUGIN-51.description: Raised when a key an author names to verify a plugin's images against cannot be read, or is not a PEM public key on the P-256 curve.

PLUGIN-6.name: NOWHERE
PLUGIN-6.description: There is no stack on this machine to put a plugin's container in.

PLUGIN-7.name: UNWRITABLE
PLUGIN-7.description: A directory or a document the install decided on would not land.

PLUGIN-8.name: UNRECORDABLE
PLUGIN-8.description: The wiring went down and the record of what is installed did not.

PLUGIN-9.name: UNPROVED
PLUGIN-9.description: The plugin's own service would not start, so nothing about it could be proved.
